overall_quality.evidence: Transformers process sequences in a parallel manner, which is fundamentally different from RNNs. RNNs process each element in a sequence one at a time, maintaining a hidden state that is updated with each new input. This sequential processing can be slow and inefficient for long sequences. In contrast, transformers use self-attention mechanisms to process all elements of a sequence simultaneously, allowing for faster and more efficient processing.
